owner_and_capability: Legacy composition — bounded contract step for #2743: the root package database/repositories deletes the repository Factory and its NewFactory constructor and is dissolved. Each retained repository adapter moved to the owner composition that may construct it (modules/*/compose, Audit and Settings per ADR 0049), and the services legacy composition builds the retained repositories where it uses them; the Timetable composition serves the retained Care Plan and Dienstplan rows over seams narrowed to their callers.

atomic_cutover: Code-only change across the #2743 branch: the Audit and Settings persistence is constructed in modules/auditlog/compose and modules/settings/compose (ADR 0049, policy epoch 35 -> 36 registers legacy-composition.to.audit-platform-compose and settings-platform.compose.postgres), every other adapter of the root package moves to its owner composition or into services, repositories.Factory and NewFactory are deleted, and the database/repositories entry leaves both the package list and legacy_composition in policy.json. The root package keeps no Go file; its subpackages are unchanged owners. The 15 #2743 keys fall with the package. The remaining 12 listed keys fall incidentally and are claimed here because the exact-equality ratchet requires removing resolved entries in the same change: api, cmd and services (#2747, #2750) and the external tests of services and modules/careplan/inbound/parent (#2747, #3421) imported database/repositories or named Factory/NewFactory only to reach the deleted aggregate.
